headline: Saudi Arabia September Trade Surplus Surges 74% as Oil Exports Jump
summary: Saudi Arabia's merchandise trade surplus surged 74.5 percent year-on-year in September 2026 as merchandise exports rose to SR115 billion, driven by a 25.6 percent increase in oil exports.
why: Saudi Arabia is the world's leading crude exporter, and its monthly trade balances reflect global energy pricing and export volume dynamics.

impacts.name: Saudi Arabia
impacts.why: Higher oil export revenues directly expand the national trade surplus.
